

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
data <- read.table("C:/Users/apubh/Downloads/preview data.txt", header = TRUE, sep = ";")
data

```

```{r}
group_number <- 4
rows_to_remove <- c(group_number * 11, group_number^2, 2 * group_number + 21)
data <- data[-rows_to_remove, ]
rows_to_remove
data

```

```{r}
str(data)

```

```{r}
summary(data)

```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Crop, y = Cstock, fill = Region)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(title = "Soil Organic Carbon Stock by Crop Type", y = "Carbon Stock (Mg C/ha)", x = "Crop Type")

```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Lutum, y = Cstock, color = Crop)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) + 
  labs(title = "Clay Content vs Carbon Stock", 
       x = "Clay Content (%)", y = "Carbon Stock (Mg C/ha)") + 
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
model <- lm(Cstock ~ Crop + Lutum + Silt + Sand + pH, data = data)
summary(model)

```

```{r}
plot(model$residuals)  
```

```{r}
soil_texture <- data %>% 
select(Lutum, Silt, Sand)
cor_matrix <- cor(soil_texture)
print("Correlation Matrix:")
print(cor_matrix)

```

```{r}
library(corrplot)

```

```{r}

corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "circle", type = "upper", tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45)

```

```{r}
library(car)
model <- lm(Cstock ~ Lutum + Silt + Sand, data = data)
vif(model)

```
```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Lutum, y = Cstock)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) +              # Scatter points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE) +  # Linear regression line with confidence interval
  labs(title = "Carbon Stock vs Lutum (Clay Content)",
       x = "Lutum (Clay Content %)",
       y = "Carbon Stock (Mg C/ha)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
confint(model)
```
